decision_conditions: The operations come within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, thereby not requiring planning permission.

Please note that this certificate is granted for the outbuilding to be used for as a  gym and storage facilities that would be incidental to main dwelling and as described on the submitted plans. It must only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 5 Boss Close, Hornchurch and not for any trade or business including meetings nor as living accommodation. Should business including meeting or living accommodation use be intended, an application for full planning permission must be applied for and permission granted before such use could occur. The use of outbuildings as living accommodation is not typically deemed acceptable therefore it is important the outbuilding is only used for the purposes as listed above.

This certificate provides confirmation that the development is lawful.  You should also check whether the development requires separate Building Regulation consent. Information is available on the Building Control webpages via http://www.havering.gov.uk/Pages/Category/Building-control.aspx?l1=200252 and the team is available between 9am and 10am Monday to Friday via 01708 432700.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for proposed erection of an outbuilding at the back of the garden, comprising a gym and storage facilities.
